verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents an API for embedded accounting and platform-to-platform integrations, but nothing in the evidence offers a downloadable machine-readable spec. Probes of common OpenAPI and Swagger paths on the help domain all returned 404. Having an API, an MCP integration or an llms.txt help index is not a downloadable OpenAPI-equivalent spec, so none of these earn credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
